text: “你疯了！”向导喊道。她举起武器，目光危险地盯着你。“那你就留下吧！等死吧。”
她退向河边。你等了几分钟，随后跟上去。如果你原本还有能用的独木舟，它已经被她带走了。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 164
text: “You are mad!” your guide cries. She raises her weapon, watching you with dangerous eyes. “Stay then! And die.”
She backs off toward the river. You give her a few minutes and then follow. If you still had a serviceable canoe, it has gone with her.
